title: Sketchy design
description: A Sketchy design: the recipe (an ordered list of features) the app replays to build the model. It is stored as plain JSON, as a .sketchy.json file, and inside a .3mf file as /Metadata/sketchy-design.json. The solid geometry is not stored; it is rebuilt from the features.

features.description: The timeline, in order. Features after `marker` are rolled back.

marker.description: How many features are applied (the rollback marker).

nextId.description: Counter used to name the next feature.

params.description: Named parameters that feature expressions can use.

units.description: Display units. All geometry is stored in millimetres.

appearance.description: Colour and material per body id.

template.description: Present on designs made from a template: the sliders shown in the Customize panel.

lastEdit.description: Who changed the design last (a person or an assistant).

thumb.description: A small preview image as a data URL.

type.description: The kind of feature, for example sketch, extrude, fillet, combine, pattern, mirror, move.

params.description: The feature's settings. Their names depend on the type. Lengths are in millimetres.

exprs.description: Settings driven by an expression instead of a number, keyed by setting name (nested settings use a dotted path such as pos.2).
